def is_hollow_rect(color, grid):
    """Check if this color forms a hollow rectangle (frame)."""
    rows = len(grid)

    if not pixels:

    min_r, max_r = min(p[0] for p in pixels), max(p[0] for p in pixels)
    min_c, max_c = min(p[1] for p in pixels), max(p[1] for p in pixels)

    full_border_pixels = set()
    for r in range(min_r, max_r + 1):
